answer: Sponsors are capped at 4 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 33 POA until the newcomer survives 16 clean epochs, and a farm of 380 fakes must find 380 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. A vine of doubt is healthy, a sparrow of proof is required, and a mirror of patience is the price of a clean panel.
